notes: I replaced the linear baseline with an asymmetric saturating curve (steep near 0, flattening at large |x|, negative side lower than positive), since E6/E8 show the baseline is not a straight line and is asymmetric. I also reshaped the dip to be deepest near |x|≈1 rather than at 0, matching E4/E8 where x=0 is less deep than x=±1.
